summary: Batch database UNLOAD utility that extracts database segments/rows (e.g. the disclosure-group / authorization support data) and writes them to a sequential output file for migration, backup, or reload. Reads the source database sequentially and writes each record to the unload file with counts.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the source database and the unload output file. Loop reading the database sequentially until exhausted: write each retrieved segment/row to the output file and count it. Close everything, report the total unloaded, and return.

annotations.note: Sequential database unload to a flat file (for migration/backup/reload).

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Open the source database and the output file; initialize the counter.

paragraphs.name: 2000-GET-NEXT-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Retrieve the next database segment/row; set end-of-db when exhausted.

paragraphs.name: 3000-WRITE-OUTPUT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Write the retrieved record to the unload file and count it; abend on write error.

paragraphs.name: 9000-FINALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Close the database and output file and display the total records unloaded.
